comment: PULU 2D clip set v2. Each frame is one image_gen call. Poses are described relative to the clip's frame 0 so the model only has to change one thing.
identity: the exact kitten from the attached reference image — silver-grey tabby with soft silver and ivory tones, white chest, white paws, big round amber eyes with a small white catchlight, tiny pink nose, thin red collar with a small round red bell bearing a white paw print, solid dark-grey fluffy tail. Chibi proportions, soft semi-realistic plush fur, gentle studio light from the upper left. Fully transparent alpha background: no backdrop colour, no floor, no cast shadow, no text, no border. Square 1:1.

clips.name: idle_observe
poses: sitting upright, facing the viewer, eyes open, neutral
head lowered slightly, shoulders settling, breathing out
head at its lowest, chest relaxed
head rising, chest expanding, breathing in
head tilts very slightly to the left, curious
back to neutral, facing the viewer

clips.name: walk_in_place
clips.anchor_pose: standing on all four legs, body seen from a front three-quarter view, walking toward the viewer, left front paw lifted mid-step
poses: left front paw touching down, weight shifting
right front paw forward, body slightly lower
weight low, both front paws near the ground
left front paw forward, body rising
body at its highest, tail swinging right
return to the start of the stride

clips.name: groom
clips.anchor_pose: sitting upright with the head lowered toward the raised left front paw, about to lick it
poses: head lowered toward the raised left front paw
tongue in, paw near the muzzle
paw lowered, head turning toward the chest
a quick shake of the head
back to a normal sitting pose

clips.name: play_bat
clips.anchor_pose: sitting with one front paw raised high, batting at an unseen toy to the left, eyes locked on it
poses: left front paw raised high, batting left
paw swinging across to the right
paw coming back, body leaning left
both front paws down, body crouched

clips.name: play_pounce
clips.anchor_pose: crouched low on all fours, hind quarters raised, ready to pounce
poses: front paws down, body still low

clips.name: turn_around
clips.anchor_pose: sitting upright, body angled about 45 degrees to the viewer's left
poses: sitting, angled 45 degrees to the viewer's left
angled to the left, almost in profile
facing away, back of the head visible
facing away at 45 degrees to the right
angled to the viewer's right, 45 degrees
slight turn to the left again
back to the 45 degree left angle

clips.name: sleep_enter
poses: head down on the paws, body curling

clips.name: sleep_loop

clips.name: stretch_exit

head turned slightly to the viewer's left
